title: Line Coverage
description: Fraction of executable lines run at least once by the test suite. Recorded facts — Metric: Line Coverage; Measures: lines executed; Target: 80%. Used by test engineers and safety assessors to argue that testing was sufficient.
demo:
# Line Coverage — runnable demo (python3)
# Line Coverage - coverage check (python3)
covered=820
total=1000
target=80.0
pct=100.0*covered/total
print("coverage: %.1f%% (%d/%d)" % (pct, covered, total))
print("TARGET MET" if pct >= target else "MORE TESTS NEEDED")
